name: Referral/fax document extractor
problem: Extract structured data from messy synthetic referrals and route exceptions to a human.
limits: Synthetic healthcare-style records only; no real PHI. Real OCR is evaluated against generated ground truth with rotation, downsampling and blur. Per-field table is evidence/field-table.md. The exception queue contains document IDs, missing field names and confidence, never patient field values. Audit logs use a value-free schema rather than attempting general PHI recognition. Zero leaks refers only to tested seeded identifiers, including a failure-path secret sentinel. System tesseract executable is required; CI installs it. This is a local queue/report demo, not a payer or clinical system.
next: Add a human-review interface with authenticated access and a larger synthetic layout corpus.
